nodes.name: 十一本账
nodes.light: the warm amber of a single oil lamp on her face and the ledgers, deep blue winter dark everywhere else, a cooler glow from the front room through the doorway
nodes.camera: level with the table edge, slightly below her eyeline, looking across the ledgers at her, the lamp in the lower left; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep winter night in the back room of a money-changer's house on the north bank of a river city. A single oil lamp stands on a heavy plain table in the near middle of the picture, and beside it a tall stack of old ledgers bound in worn brown leather, eleven of them, the topmost lying open to a page of ruled columns with one empty line. Seated behind the table, facing us three-quarter and a little to the right, is the young dragonkin copyist: a slender woman who looks about thirty, straight steel-blue hair cut at the shoulder, two small blue-green scales at her temples, pale gold vertical-slit pupils, fair skin, worn grey linen, no hood. She holds a pen above the page and has just slowed her breathing: the flame of the lamp bends slowly down toward her like a leaf, and one fat drop of lamp oil hangs trembling from the rim of the lamp bowl, not yet fallen. Her gaze is on the empty line, calm and unhurried, her mouth closed. Through the open doorway on the left, small and warm-lit, we see the front room: a counter with a hanging scale and a row of shallow coin dishes, a bald shopkeeper with copper-green stains on his fingertips weighing coins, and at the front door a young herald knight in a white tabard with a brass sun emblem driving a nail with a hammer into a notice board where a sheet is already fixed, three workers crowding behind him. Beyond the door snow is falling on a dark street. On the right a narrow wooden shutter is closed, with a little frost on the wood. Fine dust and drifting lamp smoke float large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 一幕幕终：她添满灯油、把十一年的账摞好告假（源稿第246到247行）。挑的是她放慢呼吸、灯火弯下来、油滴悬着那一拍，前屋钉告示的骑士顺带入画。账页上不写字，写成空的一行。

nodes.name: 车顶数气
nodes.light: the last cold violet-blue of dusk over the plain, a thin orange glow along the dragon's back, and the warm white of its steam
nodes.camera: low at the roadside, behind and slightly to the side of the seated woman, looking down the long straight road to the ridge; wide-angle, a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: dusk in deep winter on a long straight paved road across a white plain, seen from the roof level of a stranded wagon-camp. The road is lined for a long way with wagons that have had their wheels taken off and sit on blocks like little houses, with roofs of planks and tarpaulin, chickens pecking under them, laundry frozen stiff on lines. Far ahead at the end of the road lies a blue-grey ridge across the whole horizon like an overturned mountain: it is an ancient dragon lying asleep with its head toward us, taller than a watchtower, blue-gold scales each as big as half a man, wings folded over its back, two thin white breaths rising from its nostrils. Where the breaths pass, the snow on the paving melts into white steam that drifts toward the camp in long ribbons, though the wagon roofs are still crusted with ice. In the near left foreground, sitting alone at the roadside on the paving with her knees drawn up, seen from behind at three-quarter so that we see one cheek and one pale gold slit-pupilled eye, is the dragonkin woman: straight steel-blue hair to the shoulder, two small blue-green scales at her temple, bare feet, worn grey linen; she is watching the ridge breathe. A few paces behind her, on the right, a tiny halfling girl of about a hundred centimetres with carrot-red curls in two bunches, freckles and bare feet holds a willow switch in one hand and a leash in the other, a black dog straining toward the dragonkin woman and barking; the girl laughs, pointing the switch at the woman, and is already tying the dog to a wagon wheel. Along the roofs a few small figures stand counting breaths. Ice crystals and drifting steam fly large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕：她天天坐在路边看那道山梁出气，皮帕的黑狗见她就叫（源稿第251、253行）。龙是倦卧的样子，参考图 moon_025_1。

nodes.name: 日头半掌
who: the squire who bars the way
nodes.light: low gold sunrise from behind the wings with long rays through the wing bones, the dragon in blue-gold shadow, cold blue-violet in the snow
nodes.camera: low on the slope behind the barring squire's shoulder, looking up past her at the rising wings; wide-angle, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: sunrise on the royal road, the moment the dragon rises. An ancient blue-gold dragon has just stood up out of its long sleep and is shaking its wings open: two immense bat-like wings spread wide across the upper half of the picture, blue-gold scales lifting one by one like roof slates in a wind, so wide that their shadow falls across the whole wagon-camp and the hill beyond; its head, taller than a watchtower, is raised and turned a little away toward the east. The sun hangs one hand-breadth above the horizon behind its wings, throwing long gold rays through the gaps between the wing bones. Directly beneath its chest, tiny, sits the dragonkin woman, seen from behind and a little below, cross-legged on the bare paving: straight steel-blue hair, grey linen, her feet tucked out of sight under her crossed knees; around her the snow has melted in wide rings and white steam is rising. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, stands the squire Evelyn, a tall rangy young woman of twenty-four with short red-gold hair and bright emerald eyes, an old burn scar along one cheek, in worn leather and a white tabard with a brass sun, one spear held crosswise at hip height in both hands to bar the way; she is seen from the side at three-quarter, her jaw set, looking at the dragon. Behind her on the slope a long straight row of armoured riders sits on horses with their lances level, one commander at the left end with his arm raised, the hand open and not yet falling. On the roofs of the wagon-camp far below hundreds of small people stand silent, and a priestess at a gate holds a lamp up. Feathery steam and blown snow rush large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 三幕幕终：日头离地半掌，它站起来抖开翅膀飞走（源稿第263到265行）。画翼刚抖开、伊芙琳横枪的那一瞬，参考图 moon_025_2。伊芙琳脸上的疤在她自己的左颊。

nodes.name: 空鞘嗡鸣
who: the squire with the empty scabbard
nodes.light: clear warm gold morning light from the left, soft white steam, cool blue shadows
nodes.camera: low and close to the paving beside the groove, looking along it toward the two women, the road receding to the roofless altar-house; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: bright spring morning on the royal road, a few days after the thaw. In the middle of the road the old stone paving has been dug open along one long narrow groove, and out of the groove a rusted knight's longsword is being lifted. In the near left, large and partly cut off by the frame, kneels the squire Evelyn, tall and rangy, short red-gold hair, emerald eyes, a burn scar along one cheek, in leather and a white tabard with a brass sun emblem; she holds the sword by its hilt in both hands, drawing it up out of the stone, her mouth set, her eyes wet. At her back hangs an empty scabbard, and it is humming: faint rings of pale light ripple out from it across the air. Beside her on the right a small halfling girl of nineteen with carrot-red curls in two bunches, freckles and bare feet crouches with one finger on the groove in the paving, pointing out the line where a sword once struck. Behind them the road runs away east, steam still rising from the warm stones, and in the middle distance stands a roofless stone altar-house with its walls whole; a column of wagons is putting its wheels back on, a line of tiny people, a black dog running ahead on the paving. Far behind, small, a dragonkin woman with bare blistered feet walks back along the road with a blue-gold scale as tall as half a person on her back, a crowd gathering round her. Pale petals and drifting steam float large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 收束：皮帕读出剑砸的印子、伊芙琳挖出老骑士的剑，空鞘嗡鸣（源稿第271行）。维兰达背鳞走回来放在远处当小人（第268行）。

nodes.name: 白焰
nodes.light: the steady white-gold glow of the fire on faces, deep blue-black night and blue snow beyond it
nodes.camera: low at the children's eye level beside the fire, looking across the flames at the fur-trader; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: midwinter night in a village built in huge ancient trees at the western edge of a forest sea. The trees are taller than towers; houses and hollows are cut into trunks and roots, rope bridges link them, and thick snow lies on every branch. At the foot of the biggest tree, on packed snow in the middle of the village, a fire burns with a strange white flame, bright and steady. In the near right foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, kneels the fur-trader Emil, a broad bear of a man of nearly forty, about 186 cm, with a bushy red beard crusted with frost, a ruddy face and a big nose, in a thick fur coat and a snow-fox-fur cap; he has just struck three sparks from a flint into the kindling and looks into the fire with a wide easy grin. Around the fire, on the left and in the middle, sit a dozen children of the village, wood-elf children with pointed ears and a few human children, wrapped in blankets, laughing; the flakes falling toward them turn to steam in the white firelight before they land. At the edge of the light a ring of big pale-furred snow wolves with grey backs prowls just outside it; the heat shimmer wobbles their outlines and none of them steps across. In the far left, in the doorway of a hollow in the great trunk with strings of dried herbs hanging in it, the herbalist stands watching, a slight young-looking wood-elf woman with a pale gold braid wound with straw cord, moss-green eyes, a dried flower bud on a cord at her neck, earth on her hands, in a plain undyed tunic, and she is smiling a very small smile. Snowflakes and white sparks drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕：埃米尔敲三下火石，白焰起，狼不进来，药师笑了那一回（源稿第317行）。莉尔缇此时还没有雪狐皮（那一张是蝉鸣月埃米尔给的），所以写成素色短袍。

nodes.name: 白石泉眼
nodes.light: flat cold grey-blue light from the unmoving cloud, the faint warm gold of her hair and the pale roots the only warmth
nodes.camera: low, close to the ice, looking across her hand at her face with the snow-buried trunks rising behind; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the second winter at the edge of a forest sea, a grey-blue day. Snow is buried to the middle of the great trunks. In the near middle foreground, kneeling in the snow beside a round basin of ice, is the herbalist, a slight young-looking wood-elf woman with a pale gold braid wound with straw cord, long pointed ears, moss-green eyes lowered, a dried flower bud on a cord at her neck, in a plain undyed wool-and-linen tunic with a grey shawl, her bare hands soiled with earth. She has one hand laid flat on the spring, which has frozen into a white stone, smooth and opaque; she has just felt something move: pale roots have crept up through the snow and pushed against the ice under her palm, many fine roots pressing at the white stone, and yet no water comes. Her face is quiet and tired, her mouth closed. Around her the bark of every tree within reach has been gnawed bare by starved deer, long pale scars at deer height; a few thin deer stand far back among the trunks. High overhead the rope bridges of the village have been lifted a level higher and are crusted with snow; the houses are half buried. A snow wolf crosses the background, small. Over the whole scene a pale cloud sits low and does not move, the same colour as the snow. Fine snow and ice crystals drift large and out of focus across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕：她天天去摸冻成白石的泉眼，冰底细根挪到掌下（源稿第326行）。参考图 moon_026_1（长冬的林子边）只管整体气氛。

nodes.name: 足印生草
nodes.light: warm gold dawn light from the right low on the horizon, the cold blue of the cloud above, brilliant young green along the path
nodes.camera: low at her feet, looking up along the green path toward her face and the cloud giant above; wide-angle, a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early spring dawn, the end of three months in the snow. Under a vast pale sky an enormous seated outline made of cloud and falling snowflakes, a colossal ice-crowned shape, sits above the forest, each flake one of its scales; its crown of ice crystals catches the first light and is slowly lifting. In the near middle of the picture, walking toward us and a little to the left, comes the herbalist, a slight young-looking wood-elf woman with a pale gold braid wound with straw cord, moss-green eyes, a dried flower bud on a cord at her neck, bare earth-stained hands, in a plain undyed tunic ragged at the hem and soaked to the waist, thin and exhausted but upright, her face calm; she is walking out of waist-deep snow. Behind her the snow has parted in a long straight path of green: with each footprint she has left, grass is rising, young leaves are unfurling with drops of water on them, and at the sides of the path the ice crust is cracking open. The green road runs back and away to the right toward a village of tall ancient trees with rope bridges, where tiny people stand along a bridge looking down. The trees on each side of the path are half dead, the bark pale, but along the path small buds show on their lowest branches. Water drops, melting ice and petals of new leaves fly large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 三幕幕终：她从雪里走出来，脚印里冒出草（源稿第340行）。云里的巨影是橙冰君王，参考图 moon_026_2，只露一个坐着的轮廓。她少了一样东西，脸上不写。

nodes.name: 雪狐皮
nodes.light: low warm gold evening light through the leaves from the left, the white flame and steam glowing at her feet, cool green shade behind
nodes.camera: at root height, close, looking up past the trader's arm at her face with the old trunk rising behind; a little tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early summer evening at the roots of the oldest tree of a forest village. The village is green: shoots on the roots, birds on the branches, half the great trees bare and half just breaking into leaf. In the middle of the picture the herbalist, a slight young-looking wood-elf woman with a pale gold braid wound with straw cord, moss-green eyes, a dried flower bud at her neck, sits on a thick root with her arms wrapped round herself, shivering hard in a thin tunic, her eyes half open. Standing at her side, large and in the near right foreground, partly cut off by the frame, the fur-trader Emil, a broad man of about forty with a bushy red beard, thin now and worn, in a travel-stained coat, is laying across her shoulders a whole white snow-fox pelt, long and soft and without a mark on it, the best of twenty years of his trade, holding it by the edges so it falls round her like a cloak. In his other hand he holds a flint and steel at his thigh; three sparks are leaping from it into a heap of damp twigs at her feet, a white flame rises there, and the melting snow beside it goes up in steam. His wide blue eyes are on her face, his mouth quivering between a grin and tears; his cap is already spinning up out of the top corner of the frame. Behind them, small, village children crouch to touch the warm new grass that grows around her feet, and a few wood-elf elders watch from a rope bridge. Warm gold sparks, steam and a few drifting grains of pollen float large and out of focus across the corners.
nodes.note: 收束：蝉鸣月埃米尔回来，把二十年没卖的皮披在她身上，敲三点火星，摘帽往天上扔（源稿第347行）。

notes: 三个旅伴的死（伊芙琳、皮帕、埃米尔）都在主线年份以后（约5090、5120、5290年），在这一页5000到5300年的范围以内，我按“老死也算”各画了一幅晚年定格，源稿没有死因，是我拟的，不要的话整组拿掉。
莉尔缇的立绘资料是常年裹雪狐皮，可源稿里那一件是蝉鸣月埃米尔才给的，所以前三幅我写成素色短袍，参考图会带皮，出图时要压一下。
皮帕岁数108是19岁加上到约5120年的年数，半身人寿数要不要这么长，主会话定。
老年的伊芙琳、皮帕、埃米尔：立绘是年轻的样子，我在 text 里写了白发和皱纹，出图时参考图只管脸型和衣着。
维兰达、莉尔缇活成传奇，没有死期；路边的残兵和第四回的领兵没有立绘，没有画。

伊芙琳.how: 她把老骑士的剑背回金冕城，挂回了骑士家的墙上，第二年受了封。往后有人问起坡上那一杆枪，她说她横枪为的是别再有四百个人上去。约5090年她死在金冕城。

皮帕.where: 金冕城与神渡之间的王道
皮帕.how: 花信月她家的车装回了车轮，她解开铃舌，车铃响了一路，黑麦是头一个跑过第八座祭火院的。往后她在金冕城和神渡之间赶了一辈子的车，约5120年死。

埃米尔.how: 蝉鸣月他回了星湖，他的妻子照旧在桥头站着，等他回头看一眼，他回头了。往后他每年还来树山村，约5290年死在星湖，此后来的是他的儿子，再往后是他的孙子。

later_deaths.name: 挂剑
later_deaths.light: a long slanting shaft of warm afternoon gold from the high window onto her and the sword, soft shadow in the rest of the hall
later_deaths.camera: level, from the side across the hall, her profile in the near left and the long wall running away to the right; slightly low, a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: late afternoon in the great hall of an old knight's house in a sun-kingdom city. A long bare stone wall fills the right half of the picture, and on it, at the height of a man's eyes, hangs one rusted longsword on two iron pegs, hilt down. In the near left stands the old knight Evelyn, an old woman of about eighty-three, still tall and straight, her once red-gold hair now silver with a few red-gold strands left, bright emerald eyes still clear, and a pale old burn scar along one cheek, in a plain undyed linen gown with a white tabard folded at her shoulder and a worn brass sun badge, seen from three-quarter. She has put one hand flat on the pommel of the hanging sword and stands quite still with her eyes closed and a faint smile, as if she were listening; a long empty scabbard hangs on a peg beside the sword and a ring of faint pale light ripples out from it across the stones. On the table behind her stand a cup and a spear leaned in the corner. Warm dust motes hang in a slanting shaft of light from a high narrow window; outside, the roofs of a golden city stand small in the haze. Dust and a few floating threads of light are large and out of focus across the corners.
later_deaths.note: 源稿只写约5090年死在金冕城，没有死因。画的是她晚年手按挂着的老骑士的剑，是我拟的定格，不画躺着的人。

later_deaths.name: 车铃
later_deaths.light: low warm orange from the sunset on the right across her face, cool blue shade on the plain
later_deaths.camera: low at wheel height, looking up at the old woman on her seat with the road receding behind; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: dusk on a paved road crossing a wide plain, in the first week of spring. An old halfling woman of about a hundred centimetres, her carrot-red curls faded to the colour of dry straw but still tied in two untidy bunches, freckled round cheeks creased with age, sky-blue eyes still quick, bare feet with thick calluses, sits on the driver's seat of an old two-wheeled covered cart, seen from three-quarter on the left side of the picture. She holds in one hand the cord of a small brass cart-bell with its clapper unbound, so that the bell swings and sings; her other hand holds the reins slack. Her small mouth is open in a quiet, cheeky, tired smile. Beside her on the seat lies an old black dog with a grey muzzle, its head on her knee, ears pricked at the bell. The cart has stopped by the roadside at the foot of a low hill; ahead, small in the distance on the right, a roofless stone altar-house with a warm glow in its doorway stands beside the road, and beyond it the roofs of a golden city catch the last sun. The road is quiet and empty; a faint white steam still rises from a stretch of the paving. Fine bell-sound rings, drawn as widening pale rings in the air, and drifting dust and a few petals are large and out of focus across the corners.
later_deaths.note: 源稿只写约5120年死，没有死因，岁数是19加上到约5120年的年数，半身人寿数照这个算。画的是她赶了一辈子车的晚年定格，是我拟的。

later_deaths.name: 桥头回望
later_deaths.light: pale gold early sun low from the left over the water, cool blue mist
later_deaths.camera: from the side at bridge-rail height, a little behind the wife's shoulder, looking past her at him; a little tilted
later_deaths.text: Scene: early morning on the long stone bridge at the edge of a lake-city, in mist, in late autumn. An old man, still huge but stooped, with a wild white beard in place of the red one, about seventy-nine, in a heavy fur coat and a snow-fox-fur cap, a pack of pelts on his back and a staff in his hand, stands at the head of the bridge halfway through turning around. He is seen from the side at three-quarter in the near right, his weathered face broad and ruddy, his light blue eyes screwed up in a grin, looking back over his shoulder. A few paces behind him on the left, at the end of the bridge, stands his wife, an old stout woman in a fish-seller's apron and shawl, arms folded, scowling, who has been standing there to see him off every year; her face softens as he looks back. A cart loaded with furs waits at the roadside behind him. On the lake behind, small boats and little islands joined by bridges stand in the mist, and the first light turns the water pale gold. His breath and hers cloud in the cold air. Drifting leaves and a few snowflakes are large and out of focus across the corners.
later_deaths.note: 他死在主线之后（约5290年，主线只到5253年），源稿没有死因，画的是他每年出门、妻子在桥头等他回头那一幕的晚年版，是我拟的。
